name: hero-section-03
title: Artwork fan hero
description: A centred headline over a fanned row of artworks with a hand-drawn hint, a line of copy and two pill actions. A deck opens into the fan on load; hover or tap a card and it comes out and turns over in 3D to show the artist, title, medium and price. 4 cards on phones, 5 on tablets, 7 on desktops.

useCases: Portfolio and gallery sites that lead with the work
